## MC Hoster 1.5.0

### New
- **Updates inside MC Hoster**: when MC Hoster opens it checks for a new version. If there is one, it shows what's new and installs it with one click (it restarts by itself, your servers and auto-start keep working). There's also a **Check for updates** button on the first tab.
- **Your name** in the Settings tab: put your Minecraft name there and MC Hoster makes you op every time the server starts, and Dark Ranks gives you **OWNER** when you join. Now `/shop edit`, `/rank edit`, `/dsb edit` and the other editors just work for you.
- **Playtime money** (Dark Shop): every 30 minutes of real playing you get money: $1,000, plus $20 for every hour you've played on the server (up to $5,000). AFK time doesn't count, so nobody can farm it. `/stats` shows when your next one comes. Change it under `playtime-rewards`.
- **`/vc status`** (Dark VC Add-on): shows if you agreed to the voice chat rules and what Simple Voice Chat sees for you. Ops: `/vc status <player>`, `/vc revoke <player>`.

### Fixed
- **A server name with `!` made a server that couldn't start** (Java can't run from a folder with `!` in it), and renaming it didn't help because the folder kept the old name. Folders are now made without `!` (or `# % ^ & ;`), renaming a server renames its folder too, and servers that already have a `!` folder are fixed by themselves when you open them.
- **The OWNER rank didn't let you edit anything.** It now gets everything ops get (`*` in Dark Ranks; `plugin.*` works too).
- **Turning Stacking off in `/settings` did nothing** (Dark RS Add-on). Your setting now covers the area around you (3 chunks each way), not just the one chunk you stand in, and stacks already there are split back into single mobs and items, a few at a time so it never lags. Huge farm stacks (over 64) and spawner/block stacks are left alone.
- **Voice chat without agreeing** (Dark VC Add-on): players who didn't agree are blocked by Simple Voice Chat, but their own mic icon can still light up, so it looked like it worked. They're now told nobody can hear them until they agree.
- `/shop edit` now tells you how to get access instead of just "only ops".
